searchText: Something to read https://twitter.com/Ronin_Network/status/1508828722085867521 i think this would be useful as well! https://twitter.com/trent_vanepps/status/1508901294890790912 I don't know of a comprehensive survey, but this might be helpful: https://github.com/AntoineRondelet/crsregistry To my knowledge many of them were not runnable in the browser, so I'm not sure if there will be a lot of ceremonies with browser benchmarks. I did some rough benchmarks for the plumo ceremony using a powerful AWS machine to see how quickly I could finish the ceremony, I can dig up the numbers if that would be helpful. Another useful article from zkproof is here: <https://zkproof.org/2021/06/30/setup-ceremonies/> not quite, but thanks, might have a ceremony i was missing yes, was just reading this!
